{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Toggle or set [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]] flashlight (light source snapped to the camera).

|s1= mode call [[BIS_fnc_3DENFlashlight]]

|p1= mode: [[Number]] - can be:
* -2: restore the current mode
* -1: toggle mode
* &nbsp;0: off
* &nbsp;1: on
&nbsp;

|r1= [[Number]] - selected mode

|x1= <sqf>private _mode = 0 call BIS_fnc_3DENFlashlight;</sqf>
